phase: Phase F2h - along-track-only empirical once-per-rev accelerations (N = 300)
motivation: F2g: the four-term empirical model improved the one-day prediction (12.1 -> 4.2 m) but let the orbit rotate about the Earth line of sight (along/cross vs LOLA over the fit arc 22/25 -> 60/78 m); the cross-track terms are the free direction
change_from_F2g: S1 only (F2g's S2 basin problem is documented and not repeated here); priors on C_N and S_N tightened to N(0, 1e-11 m/s^2), i.e. effectively fixed at zero; C_T and S_T keep N(0, 1e-8 m/s^2); everything else (N=300, data, priors, Doppler bias, A1 FD sensitivities, 14 parallel workers) unchanged

gates.G3_postfit: post-fit range RMS <= 2 m and Doppler RMS <= 5 mm/s

hypotheses_reported_not_gated.H1: along- and cross-track vs LOLA over the fit arc return to <= F2f's 22 / 25 m
hypotheses_reported_not_gated.H2: the one-day prediction range RMS stays <= 6 m (F2g 4.2 m, F2f 12.1 m)
hypotheses_reported_not_gated.H3: K_SRP returns toward the 0.014 m^2/kg expected from the 1 280 kg mass
